metadata.title: Clicked like I was swatting ghosts and somehow triple gifted the enemy?! Valorant aim lost its mind
metadata.description:
Me: panicking like I forgot which button shoots
Enemy: probably uninstalling in disbelief
How did that even happen? No clue but I’ll take the chaos
If your aim ever throws a party, join me here!

Tap if your aim ever decided to go on vacation mid-game!

#valorant #luckykill #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts
